narrative.intro: BP Products North America shows $343M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. The vendor has won 16 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $21.5M and obligations up 453.7% year over year. Historical obligations peaked at $1.6B in FY22, then moved to $1.2B in FY23 and $967M in FY24 before dropping to $62M in FY25 and rising to the current $343M in FY26. The current-year total is partial because FY2026 is still in progress. These figures are contract obligations except for award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Readers should treat the FY2026 totals as fiscal year to date rather than full-year totals. The pattern shows large prior-year activity followed by a steep decline in FY25 and a partial rebound in FY26. The number of awards and the $21.5M average award size indicate a relatively concentrated set of larger-dollar obligations in the current fiscal year.

sections.heading: How did BP Products North America's federal obligations change over recent years?
sections.body: BP Products North America obligations were $510M in FY21, $1.6B in FY22, $1.2B in FY23, $967M in FY24, and $62M in FY25. BP Products North America obligations rose to $343M in FY26 to date. BP Products North America shows a large peak in FY22 followed by a decline and a partial rebound in FY26.
